coordinate_system.origin: PCB outline center projected onto the mount tray bottom outer face
coordinate_system.x_axis: X_PLUS follows increasing KiCad X without mirroring
coordinate_system.y_axis: Y_PLUS follows increasing KiCad Y without mirroring
coordinate_system.z_axis: normal to the PCB; Z_PLUS points from the tray base toward the lid and the F.Cu components

critical_requirement: H1 and H2 must remain independently exposed through continuous Z_PLUS top openings, while J1 and J2 remain accessible through separate bounded X_MINUS and X_PLUS apertures.
handoff_rule: KiCad coordinates are authoritative; every later stage must consume the previous stage artifacts.
max_component_height_definition: maximum KiCad HEIGHT_MM over installed component references; keepout radius is never a component height
title: Thermal camera calibration target PCB mount
